name: Naaman's wife
title: The Wife of the Syrian Commander
summary: Naaman's wife was married to Naaman, the Syrian commander who suffered from leprosy. She played an important role by listening to her Israelite servant girl, who spoke about the prophet Elisha, which led to Naaman's healing.

keyEvents.title: Hears About the Prophet Elisha
keyEvents.description: Naaman's wife heard from her Israelite servant girl that the prophet in Samaria could heal her husband's leprosy. She passed this message on.

keyEvents.title: The Man's Healing
keyEvents.description: Thanks to the information that spread through the household, Naaman went to Elisha and was healed by dipping seven times in the Jordan River.
